description: Production ParticleSystem isolated browser replay. Straight 15 m/s path for 3 seconds, fixed identity part frame, roll=0.5, no culling or asset delay. Lightning emitter fields from live capture; Force trail fields from decoded 0x320001AA. One emitter per run, synthetic mesh bounds only. No rendering or pixel comparison. Multipliers 5 and 10 are diagnostic hypotheses, not proposed retail values.
